title: A genetics / biologics component to the program
summary: Dylan Borland tells of A genetics / biologics component to the program, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I know there's a genetics component to it.

plain: Dylan Borland, a whistleblower, says there is a genetics part to the secret government programme that is said to recover and study non-human craft and bodies. He links this to David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who testified under oath to Congress about such programmes. If true, it would mean the programme handles living or once-living material, not just machines.
